Postponement of Skill Test & Interview for the Post of Jr. Clerk
Monday, 23 June 2025
1923 Hits
Subject: Postponement of Skill Test & Interview for the Post of Jr. Clerk Scheduled on 26/06/2025.
It is hereby informed that the Skill Test and Interview for the post of Jr. Clerk, as per Notification No. H/
Pers
/364 dated 17/06/2025, which is scheduled to be held on
26/06/2025
in the
Central Examination Hall, Kasturba Hospital, Sewagram
, has been
postponed till further notice
.
All candidates who were called for the skill test are requested to take note of this change.
Medical Superintendent
Swachhata Pakhwada - 2025
Swachhata Pakwada September 2024
paragraphs: Subject: Postponement of Skill Test & Interview for the Post of Jr. Clerk Scheduled on 26/06/2025.

It is hereby informed that the Skill Test and Interview for the post of Jr. Clerk, as per Notification No. H/ Pers /364 dated 17/06/2025, which is scheduled to be held on 26/06/2025 in the Central Examination Hall, Kasturba Hospital, Sewagram, has been postponed till further notice.
All candidates who were called for the skill test are requested to take note of this change.
